acceptedWarnings.rationale: Intentional BW-only J6 supplemental assessment: the focused review binds its combined net, oblique-view, orthographic-view and representation-switching task to BW; HE remains excluded because those competencies are distributed across J5 and J9 in the approved G8 composition.

Intentional BW-only terminal assessment for the BW-visible qualitative electrical-energy-conversion goal; the narrower endpoint avoids importing the additional solar-laboratory competencies required by the existing national solar assessment.
